categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Build system' label and directly modifies depends/packages/zeromq.mk.
categories.rationale: Disables unused ZeroMQ IPC accept filters in depends to eliminate static-linking warnings on glibc and assist with static binary builds. While it helps unblock static glibc builds, it cleans up unused code and linker warnings rather than fixing a critical platform failure or release-integrity issue.
